Definition: Release-managed resource set containing governance documents, agent instructions, and framework materials; read-only during ordinary project execution.
Mutable project truth write location; ordinary execution may write project truth only under the working root, separate from the instruction root.
Validator that checks instruction files for naming, required header, agent type declaration/table fields, required markers, and declared write scope.
Agent instruction header declaration of agent type {0|1|2}; AGENT_TYPE: 2 identifies a Type 2 candidate.
Required table with rows AGENT_TYPE, AGENT_CLASS, INTERACTION_SURFACE, WRITE_SCOPE, BLOCKING, and PRIMARY_OUTPUTS.
Explicit declaration of an agent's write scope; agents must not write outside the declared scope (K-WRITE-1).
Agent instruction with AGENT_TYPE: 2; preferred AGENT_CLASS is TASK.
Paired begin/end markers [[BEGIN:PROTOCOL]], [[BEGIN:SPEC]], [[BEGIN:STRUCTURE]], [[BEGIN:RATIONALE]] validated by begin/end pairing and section identity.
Reference state in _REFERENCES.md (REF-006) for docs/PRD.md; PRD-derived items remain warning-labeled until reconciled.
Required agent instruction header containing [[DOC:AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS]], a title, and AGENT_TYPE.
Positive and negative fixtures for complete and incomplete instruction-root asset sets.
Checklist covering required root assets and source-completeness risks, including SOW-073/OI-004 status.
Fail-closed governance for subagent requests; bridge implementation (evaluateSubagentGovernance) belongs to DEL-08-04, not DEL-08-01.
Required Type 2 subagent execution precondition along with gate/approval metadata (K-SEAL-1).
